title: In JetBrains YouTrack before 2026.2.19562 information disclosure via shared mailbox message history was possible…
description: A vulnerability in JetBrains YouTrack versions before 2026.2.19562 allowed information disclosure through shared mailbox message history. This flaw could expose sensitive information to unauthorized users with limited privileges. The issue is classified as a high severity security risk with a CVSS score of 7.7.
